request: how does the graph of a derivative match the original curve?

beats.intent: Axes with the cubic y = x^3 - 3x from -2.3 to 2.3
beats.narration: Here is the cubic x cubed minus three x.
beats.code:
stage.title("A curve and its slope")
ax = draw_axes(stage, x_range=(-2.5, 2.5), y_range=(-4, 4))
f = lambda x: x ** 3 - 3 * x
g = plot_graph(stage, ax, f, x_range=(-2.3, 2.3), color=BLUE, label="f")

beats.intent: Its turning points (-1, 2) and (1, -2) marked
beats.narration: It turns at minus one, height two, and at one, height minus two.
beats.code:
t1 = mark_point(stage, ax, -1, 2, color=RED, label="(-1, 2)")
t2 = mark_point(stage, ax, 1, -2, color=RED, label="(1, -2)", direction=DOWN)

beats.intent: A tangent sliding along the cubic, flat at both turning points
beats.narration: Slide a tangent along it: the slope is zero exactly at the turning points.
beats.code: slide_tangent(stage, ax, f, -2, 2)

beats.intent: The slope curve 3x^2 - 3 drawn in yellow
beats.narration: Plot the slope everywhere: three x squared minus three, a parabola.
beats.code: d = plot_graph(stage, ax, lambda x: 3 * x ** 2 - 3, x_range=(-1.5, 1.5), color=YELLOW, label="f'")

beats.intent: The parabola's zeros at x = -1 and 1 lined up under the turning points by dashed lines
beats.narration: Where the slope curve crosses zero, the cubic turns: the two graphs line up.
beats.code:
for x0, y0 in ((-1, 2), (1, -2)):
    draw_line(stage, ax.c2p(x0, y0), ax.c2p(x0, 0), color=GREY, dashed=True)
z1 = mark_point(stage, ax, -1, 0, color=YELLOW)
z2 = mark_point(stage, ax, 1, 0, color=YELLOW)
stage.equation(r"f'(x) = 3x^2 - 3 = 0 \Rightarrow x = \pm 1")

request: what are the chances of getting 0, 1, 2 or 3 heads from three coins?

beats.intent: Three coins as circles marked H or T, showing H H T
beats.narration: Flip three coins. One way they can land is heads, heads, tails.
beats.code:
stage.title("Three coins")
coin = lambda s, c: VGroup(Circle(radius=0.4, color=c, fill_opacity=0.7), Text(s, font_size=28))
row = VGroup(coin("H", YELLOW), coin("H", YELLOW), coin("T", GREY)).arrange(RIGHT, buff=0.3)
stage.play(FadeIn(row))
stage.add(row)

beats.intent: All 8 outcomes listed as rows of three coins
beats.narration: There are eight equally likely outcomes, two choices three times over.
beats.code:
stage.play(FadeOut(row))
outs = ["HHH", "HHT", "HTH", "THH", "HTT", "THT", "TTH", "TTT"]
grid = VGroup(*[VGroup(*[coin(ch, YELLOW if ch == "H" else GREY).scale(0.55) for ch in o]).arrange(RIGHT, buff=0.1) for o in outs]).arrange_in_grid(4, 2, buff=(0.8, 0.25))
stage.play(FadeIn(grid))
stage.add(grid)

beats.intent: The rows grouped by number of heads: 1, 3, 3, 1
beats.narration: Count heads in each: one way to get three, three ways to get two, three ways to get one, one way to get none.
beats.code:
counts = [o.count("H") for o in outs]
cols = {3: GREEN, 2: BLUE, 1: ORANGE, 0: RED}
boxes = VGroup(*[SurroundingRectangle(r, color=cols[c], buff=0.08) for r, c in zip(grid, counts)])
stage.play(LaggedStart(*[Create(b) for b in boxes], lag_ratio=0.15))
stage.add(boxes)

beats.intent: Bars of the probabilities 1/8, 3/8, 3/8, 1/8 for 0 to 3 heads
beats.narration: As chances: one eighth, three eighths, three eighths, one eighth.
beats.code:
stage.clear()
bars = draw_bars(stage, [1, 3, 3, 1], labels=["0 heads", "1 head", "2 heads", "3 heads"])

beats.intent: The middle bars lit beside P(1 or 2 heads) = 6/8
beats.narration: So a mixed result, one or two heads, happens three times in four.
beats.code:
highlight(stage, VGroup(bars[1], bars[2]), color=YELLOW)
stage.equation(r"P(1 \text{ or } 2) = \tfrac68 = \tfrac34")

request: what does the stretch matrix [[2, 0], [0, 1]] do?

beats.intent: A grid with the unit square and i-hat, j-hat
beats.narration: Start with the grid, the unit square and the basis arrows.
beats.code:
stage.title("A horizontal stretch")
p = draw_plane(stage)
sq = draw_unit_square(stage, p)
i_hat, j_hat = draw_basis(stage, p)

beats.intent: A circle of radius 1 drawn around the origin
beats.narration: Add a circle of radius one.
beats.code:
circ = Circle(radius=np.linalg.norm(p.c2p(1, 0) - p.c2p(0, 0)), color=YELLOW).move_to(p.c2p(0, 0))
stage.play(Create(circ))
stage.add(circ)

beats.intent: The matrix applied: grid, square and circle stretched sideways by 2
beats.narration: Apply the matrix: everything doubles sideways, nothing changes up and down.
beats.code: apply_matrix(stage, p, [[2, 0], [0, 1]], riders=[sq, i_hat, j_hat, circ])

beats.intent: The square now 2 by 1 labelled area 2
beats.narration: The unit square becomes two by one: its area doubled, so the determinant is two.
beats.code: stage.label(sq, "area 2", direction=UP, color=GREEN)

beats.intent: The circle, now an ellipse, beside the matrix and det = 2
beats.narration: The circle becomes an ellipse twice as wide: every area in the plane doubles.
beats.code: stage.equation(r"\det\begin{bmatrix} 2 & 0 \\ 0 & 1 \end{bmatrix} = 2")

request: what do the numbers in y = x^2 - 4x + 3 tell you about its graph?

beats.intent: Axes with the parabola y = x^2 - 4x + 3
beats.narration: Plot x squared minus four x plus three.
beats.code:
stage.title("Reading a parabola")
ax = draw_axes(stage, x_range=(-1, 5), y_range=(-2, 8))
f = lambda x: x ** 2 - 4 * x + 3
g = plot_graph(stage, ax, f)

beats.intent: The y-intercept (0, 3) marked
beats.narration: The constant, three, is where it crosses the y axis.
beats.code: yi = mark_point(stage, ax, 0, 3, color=GREEN, label="(0, 3)")

beats.intent: The roots x = 1 and x = 3 marked on the x-axis
beats.narration: It factors as x minus one times x minus three, so it crosses the x axis at one and three.
beats.code:
r1 = mark_point(stage, ax, 1, 0, color=RED, label="1", direction=DOWN)
r2 = mark_point(stage, ax, 3, 0, color=RED, label="3", direction=DOWN)

beats.intent: The vertex (2, -1) marked halfway between the roots with a dashed axis of symmetry
beats.narration: The lowest point is halfway between the roots, at two, where the height is minus one.
beats.code:
v = mark_point(stage, ax, 2, -1, color=YELLOW, label="(2, -1)", direction=DOWN)
axis = draw_line(stage, ax.c2p(2, -2), ax.c2p(2, 8), color=GREY, dashed=True)

beats.intent: The graph beside x^2 - 4x + 3 = (x - 1)(x - 3) = (x - 2)^2 - 1
beats.narration: Two forms of the same expression: the factors give the roots, the square gives the vertex.

request: how do you get the distance a car travels from its speed-time graph?

beats.intent: Axes of seconds against speed with a line rising from 0 to 20 m/s over 10 s
beats.narration: A car speeds up steadily from rest to twenty metres per second in ten seconds.
beats.code:
stage.title("Distance from a speed graph")
ax = draw_axes(stage, x_range=(0, 40), y_range=(0, 25), labels=("s", "m/s"))
up = draw_line(stage, ax.c2p(0, 0), ax.c2p(10, 20), color=YELLOW)

beats.intent: A flat line at 20 m/s from 10 s to 30 s
beats.narration: It cruises at twenty metres per second for twenty seconds.
beats.code: flat = draw_line(stage, ax.c2p(10, 20), ax.c2p(30, 20), color=YELLOW)

beats.intent: A line falling from 20 m/s to 0 between 30 s and 40 s
beats.narration: Then it brakes to a stop over ten seconds.
beats.code: down = draw_line(stage, ax.c2p(30, 20), ax.c2p(40, 0), color=YELLOW)

beats.intent: The area under the graph shaded as a triangle, a rectangle and a triangle
beats.narration: The distance is the area under the graph: a triangle, a rectangle and another triangle.
beats.code:
t1 = Polygon(ax.c2p(0, 0), ax.c2p(10, 20), ax.c2p(10, 0), color=GREEN, fill_opacity=0.5)
rc = Polygon(ax.c2p(10, 0), ax.c2p(10, 20), ax.c2p(30, 20), ax.c2p(30, 0), color=BLUE, fill_opacity=0.5)
t2 = Polygon(ax.c2p(30, 0), ax.c2p(30, 20), ax.c2p(40, 0), color=GREEN, fill_opacity=0.5)
stage.play(FadeIn(t1), FadeIn(rc), FadeIn(t2))
stage.add(t1, rc, t2)

beats.intent: The shaded shapes beside 100 + 400 + 100 = 600 m
beats.narration: A hundred metres speeding up, four hundred cruising, a hundred braking: six hundred metres.
beats.code: stage.equation(r"\tfrac12 \cdot 10 \cdot 20 + 20 \cdot 20 + \tfrac12 \cdot 10 \cdot 20 = 600\ \text{m}")

request: prove the angles of a triangle add to 180 using parallel lines

beats.intent: A triangle ABC with its three angles marked a, b, c
beats.narration: Take any triangle with angles a, b and c.
beats.code:
stage.title("180 degrees, with parallel lines")
A, B, C = np.array([-2.5, -1.5, 0]), np.array([2.5, -1.5, 0]), np.array([0.5, 1.5, 0])
tri = Polygon(A, B, C, color=BLUE)
stage.play(Create(tri))
stage.add(tri)
angA = Angle(Line(A, B), Line(A, C), radius=0.5, color=RED)
angB = Angle(Line(B, C), Line(B, A), radius=0.5, color=GREEN)
angC = Angle(Line(C, A), Line(C, B), radius=0.5, color=YELLOW)
stage.play(Create(angA), Create(angB), Create(angC))
stage.add(angA, angB, angC)

beats.intent: A line through C parallel to AB
beats.narration: Draw a line through the top corner, parallel to the base.
beats.code:
par = Line(C + LEFT * 3.5, C + RIGHT * 3.5, color=WHITE)
stage.play(Create(par))
stage.add(par)

beats.intent: The angle a copied at C on the left, between the parallel line and CA
beats.narration: Where CA crosses the two parallels, the alternate angles are equal: a appears again at the top left.
beats.code:
aTop = Angle(Line(C, C + LEFT), Line(C, A), radius=0.5, color=RED)
stage.play(Create(aTop))
stage.add(aTop)

beats.intent: The angle b copied at C on the right, between the parallel line and CB
beats.narration: The same happens along CB: b appears at the top right.
beats.code:
bTop = Angle(Line(C, B), Line(C, C + RIGHT), radius=0.5, color=GREEN)
stage.play(Create(bTop))
stage.add(bTop)

beats.intent: The three angles a, c, b side by side on the straight line beside a + b + c = 180°
beats.narration: At the top, a, c and b sit side by side along a straight line, so they add to a hundred and eighty degrees.
beats.code: stage.equation(r"a + c + b = 180^\circ")
